title.en: How often was each leg hit?

hints.tr: Üç ayrı `if` gerekiyor, `elif` değil: bir olay üç ayağı birden bozabilir.
hints.en: You need three separate `if`s, not `elif`: one incident can break all three legs.

hints.tr: `for incident in incidents:` içinde `if incident["leaked"]: counts["C"] += 1` ve ötekiler.
hints.en: Inside `for incident in incidents:`, `if incident["leaked"]: counts["C"] += 1` and the others.
